# Sky Adventures

> Sky Adventures is a Pakistani-owned mountain-travel operator based in Skardu, Gilgit-Baltistan, with 15+ years guiding treks, 6,000–8,000 m expeditions and cultural tours across the Karakoram, Himalaya and Hindu Kush. Native high-altitude guides, safety-first operations and no middlemen — 28 trips across 7 regions of Pakistan.

Contact: +92 355 5253934 (phone / WhatsApp) · skyadventurespk@gmail.com · Skardu, Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan

## Trip categories
- [Trekking](https://www.skyadventures.com.pk/categories/trekking): Multi-day treks to the base camps and high passes of the Karakoram, Himalaya and Hindu Kush.
- [Expeditions](https://www.skyadventures.com.pk/categories/expedition): Full-service 6,000–8,000 m climbs with native high-altitude staff.
- [Tours](https://www.skyadventures.com.pk/categories/tour): Cultural and blossom-season journeys across northern and southern Pakistan.

## About & planning
- [About Sky Adventures](https://www.skyadventures.com.pk/about-us): A Skardu-based, Pakistani-owned operator staffed by native Balti and Gilgit-Baltistan guides.
- [Travel tips & advice](https://www.skyadventures.com.pk/blog): Practical guidance on seasons, gear, permits, altitude and acclimatisation.
- [FAQ](https://www.skyadventures.com.pk/faq): Visas, permits, fitness, altitude, safety, weather windows, costs and booking.
- [Contact](https://www.skyadventures.com.pk/contact): Request a free, costed itinerary for any trek, expedition or tour.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Prices are quoted per group (based on size, dates and hotel standard), not as fixed headline rates — direct enquiries to the contact page or WhatsApp.
- The reliable season for most Karakoram treks and expeditions is June–September.
- All trips are operated directly by Sky Adventures with native guides; there are no middlemen or third-party resellers.
